nodes.label: Work Order Material Transfer Pattern - Stock Entry Driven
nodes.rationale: Direct required_items edits blocked post-submit. Material changes via Stock Entry only, leveraging native make_stock_entry method. ERPNext handle all validation.

nodes.label: Work Order Operation - Field Copy Convention on Create
nodes.rationale: Copies BOM Operation fields (operation, workstation, time_in_mins, batch_size, hour_rate from base_hour_rate). time_in_mins scaled by qty/bom.qty unless fixed_time. Costing uses company currency.
